# PR #3272: Patch: one page-title treatment for every menu screen

Closes #3223

## What changed

Every menu screen now names itself with one `PageTitle`. It is the screen's only `h1`, set in `--font-display` at `--type-3xl`, and it sits in the top bar's title slot (`BackLink`'s `title`, R3218000). On a phone the bar already puts it on a row under Back.

- **Brand:** the brand is no longer an `h1`. A new non-heading `Wordmark` draws it, as `.brand__word`.
- **Titles in the bar:** each of the following passes its title to `BackLink`, and its own `h1` or title `h2` is gone.
  - Tavern panels: shop, leaderboard, account, collection, ai, terms, privacy, copyright, accessibility, purchases, login, invite, reset-password and the dungeon start screen.
  - Hero screens: play, series and together.
  - Screens with a title of their own: stats, the deck workshop, almanac, patch notes, dungeon stats, replays, the replay player and practice.
- **Prompts without a bar:** `UsernamePrompt` and `ConsentPrompt` draw `Wordmark` plus a `PageTitle` inside the panel.
- **Practice:** the hidden lobby `h1` is gone. "Learn to play" and "Practice against the AI" are both `h2.section-heading`.
- **Decks:** the loading shell and the loaded workshop both say "Decks".
- **Dungeon stats:** its heading follows its tab ("Dungeon Run stats").
- **Document `<title>`:** `net/head.ts` is untouched.
- **Dead CSS:** I deleted the rules of the removed titles, and lowered the `UNSCALED` and palette counts to match.
- **Ruling and docs:** ruling `R3223000` (`spec/rulings/R3223000.md`, `spec/pending/3223.md`) and a paragraph in `apps/web/README.md`.

## Deviations from the plan

1. The legal pages' `h3` sections became `h2.section-heading`. Removing the title `h2` would otherwise leave an `h1` → `h3` gap. `privacy.css`'s `h3` rule became a `.section-heading` margin rule, and `privacy.test`'s `headings()` reads `h2`.
2. The failed-game screens in `practice.tsx` and `FightScreen` draw `PageTitle` instead of `h1.practice-stage__title` (rule deleted). The static test counts one `h1` each.
3. I removed two zh-CN keys that nothing uses now: "JackiOh — decks" and "Dungeon leaderboards".
4. `.section-heading`'s colour falls back to `--pal-gold-200`, because `/replays` is not under `.tavern`.

## Tests

- **`src/test/pageTitle.ts`:** `expectOnePageTitle` asserts one `h1`, with `data-testid="page-title"`, class `page-title`, the right text, and not hidden.
- **`routes/page-title.test.ts`:** static checks that only `PageTitle` draws a menu `h1`, that no stylesheet but `page-title.css` sets a font-size on an `h1`, and that `page-title.css` uses the display face and a type step.
- **`routes/page-titles.test.tsx` and the route tests:** each route has an `R3223000` test.
- **Existing assertions fixed:** the `level: 2` assertions became `level: 1`, and `almanac.test.tsx` now uses the test id.

## Checks run

- **Green on the first build pass:**
  - `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck`
  - `pnpm exec eslint apps/edge apps/web e2e`
  - `cargo jackioh spec check`
  - vitest over routes, together, dungeon, replay, duos, deckbuilder, practice, tutorial, auth, patches, i18n, settings, stats and the type, palette, surface, motion, typography, wording and writing guards.
  - In headless Chromium, `/terms`, `/practice`, `/login` (844x390 and 390x844), `/replays`, `/dungeon` and `/patch-notes` showed the title in the bar, the wordmark kept, and one row under Back on a phone.
- **After this pass's fix:** `src/static-pages.test.ts` (23 tests) and the web typecheck are green. I did not rerun the wider vitest list after that one-line change.
- **Not run:** Cypress, because there is no e2e server here. Specs `46` and `47` are unverified.

## The review's finding

The one red check was the web test `src/static-pages.test.ts` ("quote /privacy, /terms, … word for word from their own pages"). The finding holds. The test collected the routes' section headings with `section h3`, and those headings are now `h2`. I changed the selector to `section h2, section h3` in `apps/web/src/static-pages.test.ts`. The check is not weakened: it still requires every static heading and paragraph to appear word for word in the route.

## Decisions

- `PageTitle` is `--type-3xl`; section headings are `--type-2xl`. I rejected `--type-4xl` as too tall for a bar.
- The brand stays as a non-heading wordmark. I rejected removing it, because that would empty the tavern panels. I also rejected the stacked logo image, because it breaks one-screen heights.
- The replay player is titled "Replays", the tab's own word. I rejected a new "Replay" key, whose zh-CN meaning is "replay a lesson".

## For a person to check

- **Terms hash (R970001):** I re-hashed the current `AGREED_TEXT` row in `privacy.test.tsx`, because the page's text order changed. The words did not change and `TERMS_VERSION` is untouched. Please confirm no new version, which would make everyone re-consent, is wanted.

  - The remaining classed panel headings keep their own sizes: `play-panel__heading`, `stats-games-title`, `together-panel__heading`, `ws-group-title` and the dungeon-block `h2`s.
  - The Settings dialog's `h1` stays, because it is a modal, not a menu.
